title: Quasi-coherence of exterior sheaves on affine schemes
statement: Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum], M a quasi-coherent O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, pqf-def-coherent], and n a natural number. Then exteriorSheaf M n, the sheafification of the sectionwise nth exterior powers [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], is quasi-coherent. No finiteness or local-freeness assumption is made.

proof.text: For every affine open W and f in Gamma(X,W), the restriction map of M to D(f) is a localization. Apply exteriorPower.isLocalizedModule_of_pure_wedge to the restriction of PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower, with the coefficient-ring localization supplied by affinity. Its required pure-wedge formula is PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower_map_ιMulti.

The canonical exterior sheafification unit is bijective on W and D(f), since both are affine and M is quasi-coherent, by the upstream exteriorSheaf_affine_unit_bijective theorem. For a section on D(f), lift across this unit and use localization surjectivity to obtain an extending power multiple on W. Naturality of the unit identifies its restriction with the desired power multiple. For a section on W whose restriction vanishes, lift across the unit on W, use injectivity of the unit on D(f), and apply the localization zero criterion to obtain a killing power. Linearity of the unit transports that equation back to the exterior sheaf.

Apply the principal-open quasi-coherence criterion to the two conditions just proved. This proves the requested statement, with its original IsAffine hypothesis retained, although the local argument works on every scheme.

proof_origin.place: Retirement: existing upstream localization and affine-unit proof. The consumer transports this result through proved equality of the two exterior presheaves and their sheafifications.
